newsitem.title: ARMENIA: Armenia adopts 97 budget with big defence spending.
newsitem.headline: Armenia adopts 97 budget with big defence spending.

text.p: Armenia's parliament adopted a $325 million 1997 federal budget on Tuesday, and the document envisions heavy defence spending.

Out of total expenditures of 151.9 billion drams, 30.5 billion are to be spent on defence needs for the landlocked Transcaucasus republic of 3.5 million, which is in an unresolved territorial conflict with neighbouring Azerbaijan.
Social spending is planned at 16.8 billion drams, above the level President Levon Ter-Petrosyan's cabinet had wanted.
A deficit of 33.9 billion drams is to covered almost entirely by lending from the International Monetary Fund and other foreign lending and aid institutions.
The budget projects inflation in the former Soviet republic at an annual 10.5 percent.
"The parliament met the government halfway and adopted a budget of survival which is aimed more at needs than at development," Ter-Petrosyan told the body after it passed the document.

He emphasised the need to resolve Armenia's nine-year conflict with Azerbaijan over the disputed region of Nagorno-Karabakh as a prerequisite to relieving severe economic hardships. ($1 = 468 dram) ((--Lawrence Sheets, Tbilisi Newsroom, (+995-32) 999-370))
